recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. Do not duplicate the FHIR-32105 audit or reintroduce the R4B empty-Parameters exception into current Element solely for this extension; future definition changes belong in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-31733 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R4B/R5. It asked to reconcile structuredefinition-fhir-type JSON/rendered/R4 differences, especially the inherited ele-1 empty-Parameters invariant correction and the valueUri/valueUrl representation discrepancy, with the latter governed by FHIR-32105.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-31733 was found. The invariant path traces to FHIR-26565 commit 3d8b755ddcb632a4170d52551793c42f22a7ec47, and retained R4B history artifacts already show the Parameters-aware ele-1 invariant on the fhir-type extension. The valueUrl/valueUri part is already represented separately by FHIR-32105 commit f9dd889c776ef713c24d4ad947bb64a3d472db53 on the combined branch.
additional_context: Current core no longer owns an active structuredefinition-fhir-type definition; the definition is in the FHIR Extension Pack and constrains Extension.value[x] to url. Current core references use valueUrl, current Element source uses the later/current ele-1 expression without the R4B empty-Parameters branch, and related FHIR-33161/FHIR-34449 records point the valueUrl confusion back to FHIR-32105.
reconciliation: Made no source change. The R4B retained artifacts preserve the invariant correction relevant to this issue, FHIR-32105 already audits the valueUrl decision, and no active core source file requires a fhir-type extension edit.
